tagline: Explore. Experience. Compare. Choose Your Future.
problem_statement: Education and Careers: From Aspiration to an Achievable Plan
purpose: An interactive, student-friendly AI career exploration platform that helps students discover, experience, compare, and choose career paths before creating their first action plan.

final_experience.title: Your Future Doesn't Have To Be A Guess.

partyrock_prompt:
Build a modern, interactive, student-friendly AI-powered web application called “CareerLens AI”.

Tagline: “Explore. Experience. Compare. Choose Your Future.”

The app should help students who are unsure about their career by allowing them to discover, experience, compare, and understand different career paths before choosing one.

The application should not simply behave like a career quiz or chatbot. It should work as a Career Exploration Lab.

Core journey:
ASPIRATION → EXPLORE → EXPERIENCE → COMPARE → DECIDE → FIRST STEP

Create:
1. Interactive welcome screen with “I Know Some Careers I'm Interested In” and “I Have No Idea What Career Fits Me”.
2. Quick student profile using short questions, dropdowns, buttons, and multiple-choice inputs.
3. Career discovery engine that recommends 3–6 career areas based on interests, subjects, skills, strengths, hobbies, work style, and education.
4. Career personality snapshot explaining why careers appeared.
5. Career Experience Mode where students complete beginner-friendly simulated tasks for careers such as Software Developer, Data Analyst, UI/UX Designer, Cybersecurity Analyst, Business Analyst, and Digital Marketer.
6. Mini career challenges with a mission, estimated time, skills used, hint, result, and explanation.
7. Career comparison tool for comparing 2–4 careers across skills, education, beginner difficulty, typical tasks, creativity, analytical work, teamwork, learning curve, portfolio opportunities, and suitability.
8. “A Day in the Career” illustrative timeline showing realistic beginner-level tasks.
9. Education Path Explorer showing higher education, skill-based, project/portfolio, and experience-based pathways.
10. Skill Preview categorizing skills into beginner-friendly, practice-required, and advanced/long-term.
11. Learning Journey Preview explaining the expected learning progression without judging whether a student can succeed.
12. Career Compatibility Insight showing why a career may or may not suit the student's interests and what they would need to develop.
13. Career Switch Explorer for comparing a student's current background with a different career.
14. Career Decision Matrix helping students evaluate interest, skills, learning commitment, work style, education compatibility, project opportunities, and preferences.
15. Career Exploration Progress showing careers explored, challenges completed, comparisons made, and skills understood.
16. Career Questions AI for student questions about careers, education, skills, projects, alternatives, and next steps.
17. My Top 3 Career Options with reasons and next exploration steps.
18. First-Step Generator that provides one simple action and three immediate actions after the student chooses a career.
19. Gamification with badges such as Career Explorer, Challenge Completed, Career Comparator, Skill Detective, Path Explorer, Decision Maker, and First Step Taken.
20. Personal Career Dashboard showing careers explored, challenges completed, careers compared, favorite career, shortlist, and next step.

UI/UX:
Make the application modern, clean, attractive, interactive, student-friendly, easy to navigate, and mobile-friendly. Use cards, buttons, progress bars, timelines, comparison tables, challenge cards, icons, expandable sections, and short text. Avoid large blocks of text.

Navigation:
Home | Explore | Challenges | Compare | My Choices | Dashboard

AI personalization:
Use the student's education, interests, skills, career preferences, explored careers, challenge results, and comparisons throughout the experience. Do not give the same experience to every student.

Responsible guidance:
Never guarantee jobs, salaries, admissions, or career outcomes. Never say a student is incapable of a career. Do not treat challenge results or AI compatibility as definitive. Encourage students to verify official education and career requirements. Present multiple possible pathways.

Final screen:
Title: “Your Future Doesn't Have To Be A Guess.”
Show:
- What I Explored
- What I Learned
- What Interested Me
- What I Chose
- What I Should Do Next

Buttons:
- Start Exploring My Chosen Career
- Compare Again
- Explore More Careers
- View My Career Dashboard

The app should make the student feel:
“I explored my options, I understand them better, and I know my next step.”
